alternatives_rejected.why: Caller-observed latency jumped 5.11->88.98ms but own self-time stayed flat at 0.14->0.12ms with zero errors (E2), and logs show only successful conversions (E3). A socket leak would usually bring connection errors or failures. The socket rise (z=68, E4) fits connections held open longer behind a network delay.

Its deviation (latency-90 z=54) is much smaller than currencyservice latency-50 z=318 (E1), and currencyservice's inbound latency rose 17.4x (E2). Checkout's slowdown fits waiting on a delayed currencyservice.

proposed_fix.description: Check the currencyservice pod and node network for an injected delay (e.g., a tc/netem qdisc or chaos experiment) and remove it. Then verify that inbound p50 latency returns to about 5ms and socket counts normalize. If the delay can't be removed directly, reschedule the currencyservice pod to a healthy node.
